description: Smart money here means the PROVEN cohort: Hyperliquid accounts screened for real profit and verified by their own fills. view: smart_money (default: what that cohort holds and trades per coin), proven (who they are, by trader number), screened (every wallet screened from closing fills, a weaker claim), board (tracked big accounts: equity, leverage, bias), moves (opens, adds, trims, closes, flips just now), dex (wallets moving the most on DEXes).

chain.description: ethereum, base or arbitrum. Omit for all.

coin.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC. A pair like ETH/USD works too.

cursor.description: Next page: the cursor from the previous answer.

detail.description: brief (default): the answer, key numbers and top rows. full: every row, paged with cursor.

kind.description: moves only: open, add, trim, close or flip.

limit.description: Rows to return (usually up to 100; more is clamped and said).

since_ms.description: Only rows newer than this Unix-ms time (polling cursor).

name: traders

access_note.description: What this connection could not return.

available.description: False: no data; note says why.
